name: Sign in and keep a long-lived session
description: Verifies a valid account can sign in and remains authenticated until explicit sign out or revocation.
expected: The existing session remains authenticated after inactivity and explicit sign out returns the user to the signed-out screen.

name: HOTICE navigation, profile and settings
description: Verifies the primary HOTICE areas, Profile and the authenticated three-dot menu remain reachable.
steps: Observe Chats, Status, Calls, Marketplace and Profile
expected: All five core areas remain available, Profile opens correctly, and the menu exposes Settings.

name: Marketplace seller and buyer workflow with media
description: Verifies seller creation and buyer listing flows, including listing media and stock state.
steps: Choose one image or video at or below 20 MB
Open the listing and observe its media and seller/store details
expected: The listing persists with its media, zero stock displays as out of stock, seller/store details are visible, and save/unsave works.

name: Shared Marketplace card uses refreshable media
description: Verifies shared Marketplace cards store listing identity rather than an expiring signed media URL.
steps: Open a Marketplace listing with an image
Observe the Marketplace card and current image
Observe the Marketplace card and current image
expected: The listing appears as a rich card in chat and Status, current media is fetched from the listing endpoint, opening the card reaches listing detail, and ordinary text remains text.

name: Start and receive a 1:1 voice call
description: Verifies a direct call invitation remains available alongside the Marketplace changes.
steps: Actor A starts a voice call
Actor B observes the incoming invitation
expected: Actor B sees the call invitation with accept and decline controls.
